Sess"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ion state stays in DSH; durable bindings live in the profile's storage domain."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Mention-driven sessions** — an authorized `@bot <task>` in a bound channel anchors a thread (you"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"r message becomes the first post), creates the DSH session, and submits the prompt at most once. Fol"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"low-ups inside the thread queue without a mention. Attached images ride along: they are downloaded f"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"rom the Discord CDN within strict size/host bounds and submitted as image parts for multimodal model"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"s.
- **Stream rendering** — typing indicator, one head message edited in place, per-tool activity ro"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ws, fenced long-answer splitting, one-time finalize; the activity message is deleted when the turn e"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"nds.
- **Approvals & questions (dual surface)** — DSH asks become buttons, select menus, and a free-"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"text modal, mirrored to the web/desktop panel at the same time: the first surface to answer wins and"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" the other auto-retires (Discord carries the ask alone when no web client is connected). Ownership i"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"s enforced (the asker — or the thread owner on later turns — clicks), expiry sweeps fail closed, and"},{"id":"p7s11","text":" settled controls grey out in place.
- **Session control** — `/steer`, `/stop`, and `/queue list|rem"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"ove` with turn-ownership checks; `/project bind|list|info` and `/session resume` for guild↔workspace"},{"id":"p7s13","text":" binding and history; `/guild forget` for operator cleanup.
- **Model selection** — `/model show` re"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"ads the session's live model directory; `/model select` walks an interactive provider → model → reas"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"oning cascade, or applies a typed `provider/model` directly. Open to any authorized member by defaul"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"t; restrictable to Host operators.
- **Adapter status** — `/info` shows the adapter version, connect"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"ion state, and project links (feedback, docs). Works in any channel.
- **Permission switching** — `/"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"permission show` / `set` read and switch the session's permission preset (bundled sandbox + approval"},{"id":"p7s19","text":" tiers) through the Host's own `/permission` command path, inheriting its journal audit pair; `dange"},{"id":"p7s20","text":"r-full-access` requires a button confirmation.

- **Verbosity is a single global setting** (the DSH ecosystem has per-channel precedent).

- **Known tension**: t"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"he 250ms minimum stream-edit interval against Discord's edit budget under heavy load (429s self-heal"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"), and typing has no duration-capped watchdog."}],"truncated":true}
